ownerDirection: 2026-10-19: owner approves the goal of independently checked, high-quality AI news posting without reviewing every finished article
permissionBoundary: A future autonomous production-release lane requires separately tested evidence-based editorial approval. Never label model output as site-owner signed approval or convert existing manual approvals.
mandatoryFutureGates: Official original page and independently checked original publication date
Factual claim-to-primary-source evidence plus material restrictions
Meaning-based duplicate/rejected-topic screening beyond identical URLs
Multi-pass independent critical review; contradictions or evidence gaps BLOCK
One-minute original Japanese copy with clear conclusion and baseline difference
Original licensed/owned illustration with validated WebP SHA256
Published prerequisites, source URLs, article registry, immutable manuscript SHA
Deterministic Test/Lint/Build, publication rollback and post-deploy verification
Cost and request limits and a per-provider error circuit-breaker (not a daily publication quota)
safeFallback: No autonomous publication if any prerequisite is missing or ambiguous. Skip news rather than invent facts.
